claims.text: Fenwick Mutual is a regulated financial institution seeking support to rebuild its enterprise risk framework ahead of a supervisory review.

The scope includes designing a three‑lines‑of‑defence operating model, rationalising the control library without loss of coverage, and closing outstanding regulatory findings within two review cycles.
Respondents must evidence comparable regulatory remediation work and describe how quality will be independently assured.
VCG will apply its four‑phase delivery methodology—Diagnose, Design, Deliver, Sustain—to structure the risk framework rebuild.
A joint steering committee will be established and will meet fortnightly to govern the engagement.
For engagements longer than six months, VCG assigns a dedicated Engagement Quality Director who operates independently of the delivery team to assure quality.
Knowledge‑transfer workshops will be conducted in the final four weeks to embed the new operating model within Fenwick Mutual’s teams.
VCG built a three‑lines‑of‑defence operating model for Northbank Financial, rationalising 62 controls to 38 without loss of coverage.
The Northbank engagement closed all outstanding regulatory findings within two review cycles.
The Northbank project was delivered over seven months by a five‑person team.
VCG redesigned Larkfield Group’s operating model across five business units, removing three management layers and reducing decision‑cycle time by 31 percent.
VCG’s firm credentials include 2,000 consultants across six practices, operating in 12 markets, with an average engagement team size of seven consultants.
Since 2020 VCG has delivered 340 engagements and achieved a client repeat‑engagement rate of 68 percent.
VCG’s risk advisory practice combines deep regulatory expertise with proven operating‑model redesign experience, as demonstrated in the Northbank and Larkfield projects.
The firm’s structured methodology and independent quality oversight ensure that remediation work meets supervisory expectations.
VCG’s track record of closing regulatory findings within two review cycles aligns directly with Fenwick Mutual’s timeline requirements.
We are well placed to deliver Fenwick Mutual’s enterprise risk framework rebuild on schedule and with independent quality assurance.
